title: Trump bought at least $51 million in bonds in March, disclosure shows
title_zh: 披露显示，特朗普3月份购买了至少5100万美元的债券
summary: By Laura Matthews NEW YORK, April 25 (Reuters) - U.S.
summary_zh: 作者：Laura Matthews 纽约，4 月 25 日（路透社）- 美国

title: Insider Trading Cases Threaten Reckoning for Prediction Markets
title_zh: 内幕交易案件威胁预测市场的清算
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Prediction markets have quickly grown from a niche corner of finance to a multibillion-dollar industry with big Wall Street investment, but a growing list of insider trading allegations is bringing concerns about the platforms all the way to the White House.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——预测市场已经从金融的一个小众角落迅速发展成为拥有华尔街巨额投资的数十亿美元行业，但越来越多的内幕交易指控正将人们对这些平台的担忧一直带到白宫。

title: Big Tech's jobs cuts feel like an economic warning
title_zh: 大型科技公司的裁员感觉像是一个经济警告
summary: The richest and most successful companies are cutting jobs.
summary_zh: 最富有和最成功的公司正在裁员。

title: Nvidia stock clinches record close, pushing market cap over $5 trillion once again
title_zh: 英伟达股价创历史新高，市值再次突破 5 万亿美元
summary: Nvidia was on pace for a record-high close as the AI leader and most valuable company in the world crossed the $5 trillion valuation mark again.
summary_zh: 随着人工智能领导者和全球最有价值公司的估值再次突破 5 万亿美元大关，英伟达有望创下历史新高收盘价。
